subject.title: feat: ask_user — structured questions from the agent with web card, channel buttons, and text answers

question: Should OpenClaw ship this new provider-neutral Gateway question and plugin-SDK contract as a core product surface after the native-token upgrade path is specified?
rationale: The PR creates persistent public RPC, scope, SDK, and multi-channel behavior; choosing its long-term core contract and upgrade expectation requires maintainer intent beyond a mechanical repair.

options.title: Sponsor the core contract
options.body: Approve the provider-neutral question surface, require the native profile/upgrade repair and final-head proof, then continue normal merge review.

options.title: Narrow to existing Codex support
options.body: Keep the already merged Codex-specific question bridge and defer the new generic Gateway and SDK surface.

options.title: Route the generic layer elsewhere
options.body: Pause this PR while maintainers decide whether a smaller plugin-facing seam should replace the new core RPC contract.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the core contract
recommendation.body: Approve the provider-neutral question surface, require the native profile/upgrade repair and final-head proof, then continue normal merge review.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the most directly connected contributor across the merged Codex foundation and this proposed generic follow-on.
